user.title: Connect to Proxmox Mail Gateway
user.description: Enter the connection details for your PMG instance. The integration will verify the connection before saving.

data_description.verify_ssl: Disable for PMG instances using a self-signed certificate (default for new PMG installations).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Proxmox Mail Gateway
reauth_confirm.description: Update connection details and enter your password to re-authenticate with PMG.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to PMG: {error_detail}. Check the host, port, and network connectivity.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials: {error_detail}. Verify username, realm (@pam or @pmg), and password.
error.insufficient_permissions: Insufficient permissions: {error_detail}. The user cannot access quarantine (/quarantine). Assign an appropriate role in PMG.
error.ssl_error: SSL certificate verification failed: {error_detail}. Disable 'Verify TLS certificate' if PMG uses a self-signed certificate.
error.timeout_connect: Connection to PMG timed out: {error_detail}. Verify that host IP and port 8006 are reachable.
error.server_error: PMG internal server error: {error_detail}. Check pve-api-daemon service on PMG.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred: {error_detail}. Check the HA logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This PMG instance is already configured.

init.description: Adjust connection parameters and sensor settings.

data_description.password: Only enter a new password if you wish to change it.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll PMG for new quarantine data. Minimum: 10 s, maximum: 3600 s.
data_description.enable_postfix_sensors: Creates sensors for active, deferred, and incoming Postfix queue depths.
data_description.enable_node_sensors: Creates a sensor for the PMG node's CPU utilisation.
